items.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: Yeah. I learned that from “Peter and the Wolf.”

ctx.x: Yeah. I learned that from “Peter and the Wolf.” The orchestration is bad. The melodies are humorous you know, but the orchestration is bad.
I agree. And like — what’s the Tchaichovsky they always play at Christmastime?
Yeah. That’s with the “Dance of the Sugarplum Ferry.”
